author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be the most dangerous AI, Mythos reportedly being hacked and accessed by people it wasn't supposed too. How did this happen? Let's find out and let's also see why Mythos isn't going to be as important a year from now when more and more people get access to similar class models locally or through other vendors. Thanks for watching!

title: The Most Dangerous AI Got Hacked...
